item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I really shouldn't upvote something with a blatant Python pastiche in it, but it was just carried off with such panache, and it was properly rewritten instead of being a find-and-replace job… The final few lines remind me of something too, but I can't quite work out what. The Young Ones, possibly?

Have my +1, dammit.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I like the density of references in here; they're subtle enough to integrate this piece firmly into the world without detracting from the story.

Tangential note: I find it interesting that people really seem to want to believe that 2718 isn't as horrifying as presented. This feels like the 2nd or 3rd time I've specifically heard the 'quantum retrocausality tech caused it' explanation.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I see what you did there with Pepper. Anyway, this was well written and gave interesting characters. Not sure about the Night Vale reference but I guess it's because I just don't know much about it to see why reference it.

Hope to see more of Pepper though. She is now another favorite character.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I still really dislike the warmed-over parrot sketch homage, but there are some skilful flourishes in here, and they deserve an upvote.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I thoroughly enjoyed this. The fake Sarkicist being exposed, the Maxwellist trying to unload a Night Vale cat, and the mopey dead girl - all clearly depicted and believable. The bargaining between Victor and Manny sounded like actual people talking.
A satisfying addition to both the Circus and Mickey D.

Addendum: I forgot to mention the excellent Monty Python call-out.
